A settled planet makes the goods its class sells, faster with more people, into its storage (none while besieged). Ports trade by the planet's class: every good is sold and bought somewhere at Sol.
People per unit of size, times the planet's size (1–16; gas giants 16–63), is its population cap. Moons give 6 weapon mounts each. Idea: moons mined for water ice and metals once a planet has a
